role: replace the 500-item Banking77 subsample with the whole official test split
claim: Every system below was already scored on the 500-item subsample, which is a subset of these 3080 rows. Nothing is refit: each system keeps the temperature it fit on the 400 Program 1 dev rows, and the cascade keeps the dev thresholds in artifacts/hybrid/thresholds.json. Written before any system was scored on the other 2580 rows.
split: official test, every row, in file order

systems.deberta-v3-large-zeroshot-v2.0-c: Program 1 system, temperature refit by the Program 1 rule on its saved dev scores, which reproduces the Program 1 value
systems.jev: jev_protocol.json request and score rule; temperature from the jev dev rows; rows that return an error are requested again, up to 4 passes

cascade.controls: random and oracle as in hybrid_protocol.json

intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap over items, 2000 resamples, seed 20261008
macro_f1: unweighted mean of per-class F1 from the argmax decision, reported next to accuracy
